findings.highlight: The only ones remaining on the stage are silent corpses
findings.evidenceJa: 舞台に残されたものは物言わぬ屍のみ
findings.governingReading: the only thing left on the stage is a silent corpse
findings.explanation: mirror moon pluralizes the single body and grammatically turns the corpse into people.

findings.highlight: Something is devouring the corpses. No bodies remain
findings.evidenceJa: 何かが、呑み込んでいた。死体は残らない
findings.governingReading: something was swallowing it; the corpse will not remain
findings.explanation: The single observed corpse becomes multiple corpses and a completed plural outcome.
mirror moon replaces the intact motionless body with flesh, intensifying gore while losing the corpse’s form.
A tactile, visually bounded stain becomes generic spilled blood.

findings.highlight: The soul that was Servant Caster
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターを象っていた魂とも言えるもの
findings.governingReading: something one might call the soul that had formed or given shape to Caster
findings.explanation: mirror moon turns a hedged description of what constituted Caster into an ontological identification with her soul.

findings.evidenceJa: 黒い影に落下していく
findings.explanation: A downward movement into a specific shadow becomes passive consumption by generic darkness.

findings.highlight: The defeated Servants are to be consumed by the Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: 消滅したサーヴァントの行き着く先は聖杯のみ
findings.governingReading: the Holy Grail alone is the destination of a defeated, vanished Servant
findings.explanation: The English changes the rule governing destination into a claim that the Grail consumes Servants.

findings.governingReading: no matter what kind of thing or entity it may be
findings.explanation: mirror moon humanizes the unknown entity and later assigns it a male possessive.

findings.highlight: it will only bring his own death and destruction
findings.evidenceJa: 自滅自虐は避けられまい
findings.governingReading: it cannot avoid self-destruction and self-torment
findings.explanation: The English replaces inevitable reflexive destruction and abuse with a causal prediction of male death and generic destruction.

findings.governingReading: while being exposed or laid bare
findings.explanation: The grammatical direction reverses: something else lays the entity bare, but mirror moon makes the act voluntary and reflexive.

findings.governingReading: it walks with soft wet or pattering footsteps
findings.explanation: The English omits the sound and texture of the entity’s approach and adds onward continuation.
mirror moon removes the demonstrative link and the marked katakana presentation of the entity’s pain.

findings.evidenceJa: そんな機能は付属していない
findings.governingReading: such functions were never equipped or attached to it
findings.explanation: The English preserves absence but loses the mechanical language presenting the entity as something constructed without those faculties.

findings.highlight: It has become aware of its existence for the first time
findings.evidenceJa: 自らの存在。自らが存在するという事に、いま、初めて気がついた“何か”のように
findings.governingReading: as though it were some “thing” that has only now, for the first time, realized both its own existence and that it exists
findings.explanation: mirror moon collapses the deliberate repetition, omits “now,” and removes the distancing quotation around the newly self-aware “something.”
